world.title: Bangladesh garment workers clash with police as pay protests shut factories
world.summary: Bangladesh garment workers protested for higher wages on Tuesday, blocking roads in a major industrial area. The demonstrations led to clashes with police, who responded by using tear gas and sound grenades. The unrest disrupted production, resulting in the suspension of operations at numerous factories. Authorities reported significant impacts on the garment industry due to the ongoing protests.

world.title: US envoy 'not certain' military aid to Israel will end this year as Trump promised
world.summary: US Ambassador to Israel Mike Huckabee expressed uncertainty about the potential cessation of $3.8 billion in annual military aid to Israel by year-end, despite President Trump's earlier promise. Huckabee noted that the funding had already been allocated by Congress and indicated that stopping it would likely require congressional approval, complicating the situation regarding U.S. military support for Israel.

world.title: Thousands Protest In Karachi Against Asim Munir's Gamble To Redraw Pakistan
world.summary: Thousands protested in Karachi against Field Marshal Asim Munir's proposal to redraw the maps of four key provinces: Punjab, Sindh, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, and Balochistan. The plan, linked to Munir's influence as military chief, has sparked political controversy, although no official blueprint has been released. The protests reflect growing public concern over military involvement in political matters.

business.title: TVS Jupiter Achieves Production Milestone of 1 Crore Units
business.summary: TVS Motor Company announced the production milestone of 1 crore units for its Jupiter scooter. The landmark 1 croreth unit was produced at the company’s manufacturing facility in Hosur, Tamil Nadu. This achievement highlights the popularity and demand for the TVS Jupiter in the Indian market, marking a significant milestone in the company’s production history.

business.title: 26-Year-Old Google Employee Earns Rs 3 Crore, But Spends Under 10% To Retire Early. Here's His Plan
business.summary: A 26-year-old Google employee earning approximately Rs 3 crore annually adopts a frugal lifestyle to retire early. He shares an apartment with four roommates, walks or cycles to work, and uses public transport instead of owning a car. Additionally, he takes advantage of free meals at the office, spending less than 10% of his income.

business.title: HPE Expects Thinner AI Margins. Is Dell Next?
business.summary: Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) reported a significant increase in server sales, nearly doubling its figures and raising its outlook. However, the company anticipates thinner profit margins, expecting to retain less from each dollar earned. This news follows Nvidia's substantial market valuation increase of $954 billion in a single day, raising questions about leadership stability within the tech industry.

technology.title: GTA 6 Easter egg takes players back to original Vice City with PS2 graphics: How to unlock it
technology.summary: GTA 6 players have found a hidden Easter egg that allows the protagonist, Jason, to visit a recreation of the original 2002 Vice City. This feature includes PS2-era graphics, the Malibu Club, and familiar characters from the original game. The Easter egg was revealed within the context of Rockstar Games' fictional Leonida, enhancing the nostalgic experience for players.

technology.title: Best Black Friday Apple Watch deals 2026: Prices start at just $179
technology.summary: Black Friday Apple Watch deals for 2026 feature significant discounts, with prices starting at $179 for the Apple Watch SE 3. Additionally, customers can save $100 on the Ultra 4 model. Major retailers like Amazon and Best Buy have begun their official sales, offering a variety of deals as the holiday shopping season approaches.

technology.title: Motorola launches Edge 70 Neo for premium segment buyers in India
technology.summary: Motorola launched the Edge 70 Neo in India on November 24, 2026, targeting premium segment buyers. This new model complements the existing Edge 70 series, which includes the Edge 70 Pro, Fusion, and Max. The Edge 70 Neo features a 6.8-inch 1.5K Extreme AMOLED Super HD display, enhancing Motorola's offerings in the premium smartphone market.

sports.title: 'That's how cut off I am': Parore's Kohli airport moment
sports.summary: Former New Zealand cricketer Adam Parore reflects on his post-retirement life, 20-25 years after leaving international cricket. He has built a successful career in corporate finance and private equity, embracing diverse experiences. Parore expresses contentment away from the limelight and recently became a father to twins, highlighting his fulfilling transition from sports to a new professional path.

sports.title: South Africa name multi-format squads for India home series
sports.summary: South Africa has announced their squads for the upcoming home series against India, featuring several new players. Laura Wolvaardt will captain the team across all three formats. The series begins with a four-day Test starting December 9, followed by One Day Internationals and T20 Internationals. This marks South Africa's first home series against India in this format.

sports.title: Asia Cup Rising Stars (50 Overs)
sports.summary: Pakistan A faced Nepal in the 11th Match of the Asia Cup Rising Stars (50 Overs) 2026, with Pakistan A scoring 168 all out in 42 overs. Key performances included a top score of 64 runs. The match featured various individual contributions, including boundaries and extras. Detailed statistics and the complete scorecard are available on ESPN.in.

health.title: The Surprising Link Between Sleep Deprivation, Memory, & Caffeine
health.summary: Sleep deprivation significantly impacts memory and cognitive functions, making tasks more challenging. It alters brain regions responsible for memory processing. While many rely on caffeine to counteract these effects, its efficacy may vary. Understanding the relationship between sleep, memory, and caffeine can help individuals manage their productivity and cognitive performance more effectively, highlighting the importance of adequate rest.

health.title: Offit says measles is endemic in the US again as a CDC alert sits blocked
health.summary: Paul Offit, a vaccine developer, claims the U.S. has lost its measles elimination status, citing a rise in deaths. In the past 25 years, three people died from measles, but in the last 20 months, 13 have died, including half adults. This increase highlights the urgency of addressing the CDC alert, which remains blocked, according to Offit.

health.title: Mizoram records decline in new HIV infections: Official
health.summary: Mizoram State AIDS Control Society Project Director Dr. Jane Rinsangi Ralte announced a decline in new HIV infections in the state. The number of newly detected cases decreased to 1,628 in 2025-2026, down from 2,236 previously. This trend reflects ongoing efforts to combat HIV in the northeastern state, highlighting improvements in public health initiatives and awareness.

science.title: NASA's Webb Telescope Reveals Hidden Changes Before Star's Explosion
science.summary: NASA's James Webb Space Telescope has provided new insights into Cassiopeia A, a supernova remnant from a massive star's explosion. Recent findings, published in The Astrophysical Journal Letters, detail structural changes in the star prior to its explosion. These observations enhance understanding of stellar evolution and the processes leading to supernova events, contributing to astrophysical research.

science.title: Hidden planet lurking beyond Neptune? New simulations offer clues
science.summary: New simulations suggest a hidden planet, 1.5 to 2 times Earth's mass, may exist beyond Neptune. This hypothetical planet could explain the unusual orbits of distant icy objects in the solar system. Astronomers have long speculated about such a planet, and these findings provide new insights into its potential mass and location, reigniting interest in the search.

science.title: Triple Star System Welopōʻai: What Is It? Explained
science.summary: Astronomers have discovered a triple-star system named Welopōʻai, the closest known system of its kind, located within 100 light-years of Earth. It consists of three stars, including two white dwarfs. The existence of such a system raises questions among scientists, as no similar configurations have been observed nearby. Welopōʻai challenges existing theories about star formation and evolution.

entertainment.title: Guru Randhawa faces police complaint and legal warning ahead of Delhi concert over alleged glorification of drugs and alcohol, gets 7-day warning
entertainment.summary: Singer Guru Randhawa is facing a police complaint and legal warning ahead of his 'Sirra Tour' concert in New Delhi. The controversy arises from allegations of glorifying drugs and alcohol in his music. Authorities have issued a seven-day warning to address the concerns. The situation has sparked discussions regarding the impact of music on societal issues.

entertainment.title: Akshay Kumar, Karan Johar come out in support of Deepika Padukone's 8-hour shift demand: 'She’s earned that right, she’s a hardworking woman, a mother and a wife'
entertainment.summary: Filmmaker Karan Johar has expressed support for Deepika Padukone's call for an eight-hour workday, emphasizing that actors should be able to establish boundaries regarding their work commitments. He highlighted Padukone's dedication as a hardworking woman, mother, and wife, questioning the criticism surrounding her request. Akshay Kumar also backed her stance, reinforcing the importance of work-life balance in the industry.

entertainment.title: Watch: “K-Pop: The Debut” Teases Ji Young Yoo’s Journey With Cameos From Joshua, Jay, Jake, KATSEYE, And More
entertainment.summary: The film "K-Pop: The Debut" has released its first trailer, showcasing the journey of Lizzy, played by Ji Young Yoo. A Korean-American woman, Lizzy decides to follow her dream of becoming a singer rather than attending medical school. The trailer features cameos from Joshua, Jay, Jake, and KATSEYE, highlighting the film's connection to the K-Pop industry.
